pane.description: A labeled box: header strip plus children. Used inside compare/diff, or standing alone.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The header strip's text. Omit it for an unlabeled box.

compare.description: Lays two or three tech_pane children side by side, stacking on narrow width.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: A small heading above the panes.

diff.description: Side-by-side before/after code panes with a self-written line diff.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: A small heading above the panes.

method.description: A colored HTTP method chip followed by a monospace path.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: The request path, shown in monospace after the chip.

status.description: A lifecycle badge: stable, beta, experimental, deprecated, removed, nightly, or unsafe.

attributes.name: since
attributes.description: Appended inside the badge as since <value>.

verified.description: A one-line record of a manual verification: result, environment, date, and note.

attributes.name: env
attributes.description: The environment verified in, shown in monospace.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: How it went. Anything else renders a neutral marker.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A short muted note at the end of the line.

tradeoff.description: Two columns, Pros and Cons, built from tech_pros/tech_cons children.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: A small heading above the columns.

pros.description: A labeled Pros block; a column inside tech_tradeoff, or a standalone list.

cons.description: A labeled Cons block; a column inside tech_tradeoff, or a standalone list.
